newsitem.title: ITALY: Telecinco says H1 '97 profits up 122 pct.
newsitem.headline: Telecinco says H1 '97 profits up 122 pct.

text.p: Spanish TV group Telecinco, where Italian multi-media company Mediaset has a 25 percent stake, reported on Monday first half 1997 gross profits up 122 percent at 8.047 million pesetas.
The company said in a statement that consolidated first half 1997 sales had risen 27 percent to 29.606 million pesetas from 23.402 million pesetas previously.
The statement said that the group's net operating margin rose 82 percent to 8.142 million pesetas, with operating costs increased 13 percent to 21.464 million pesetas in the first six months of 1997.
